mechanism_family: cross-sectional momentum / relative strength / factor ranking
lineage: NEW. Distinct from EXP-ARP-008 (single-asset time-series momentum). Distinct from EXP-ARP-016 (raw trailing return, no volatility normalisation, no skip window) by using a RISK-ADJUSTED formation score with a 7-day skip.
mechanism_statement: Rank the eligible universe cross-sectionally by formation return divided by realized volatility, skipping the most recent 7 days; hold the top decile equal-weight and rotate.

rules.holdings: long equal-weight top decile of eligible universe (min 5 names, max 20 names)
rules.rebalance: every 7 days at UTC close; act next open; only names whose rank changed are traded
rules.stop: none (rotation is the exit); max_hold_days force-exits a name at the next open
rules.position: long-only; fixed total notional 500 USD spread equally; no compounding

spec_contract.entry_rule: long top-decile risk-adjusted relative strength, rebalance every 7d, act next open
spec_contract.exit_rule: exit a name when it leaves the top decile or after max_hold_days; act next open; no bar-close force

implementation_config.entry_rule: long top-decile risk-adjusted relative strength, rebalance every 7d, act next open
implementation_config.exit_rule: exit a name when it leaves the top decile or after max_hold_days; act next open; no bar-close force
implementation_config.disposition: NOT_IMPLEMENTED — pre-registration only; no DEV execution in ARP-008

kill_criteria: DEV gross expectancy <= cost bps -> REJECT_COSTS
single trade > 50% of positive DEV net -> REJECT_FRAGILE

prior_art.difference: ARP-016 ranked raw trailing return with no volatility normalisation and no skip; this ranks risk-adjusted return with a 7-day skip.

gates.promotion: positive net DEV AND positive net VALIDATION AND cost PASS AND robustness PASS AND PIT PASS AND contract PASS AND sample sufficient AND concentration acceptable AND builder != verifier
